$comment: The audit's stages, in the one order figma-project-audit runs them: the only list of them. The dashboard (tools/docs-site/src/dashboard/audit.js), bin/audit (tools/figma-audit/audit-session.mjs) and Audit lite (plugins/audit-lite) each run the stages that name them in `runners`, in this order, with the scripts named here; skills/figma-project-audit/tests/test-stages.mjs fails when a runner handles a stage this list does not give it, or this list gives a runner a stage it has no handler for. Order matters only when fixes land between stages; a runner that applies none may run components first.

$fields.id: the stage's handle; each runner keys its handler by it
$fields.label: the stage's name as Audit lite's checkbox, and in its report's list of checks run; the dashboard's run lines name a stage by the queue chip its rows land under (dashboard/labels.js), never by this
$fields.description: one plain line under that name saying what the stage looks at, written for a designer; the only copy of it
$fields.owner: the skill whose rows the stage files, and the only one that closes them
$fields.target: the queue it files under, beside its owner; null for the owner's main queue, "setting:<key>" for one a setting names
$fields.gather: what runs in Figma: `script` from the repo root; `shadow` globals declared undefined first, so a plugin's own `__html__` leaves the snapshot plugin headless; `set` the constants prepended (a list: values the runner supplies from settings; an object: these values); `call` the function whose value the body returns; `served` its key in the dashboard service's GET /scripts
$fields.checks: what runs on the gathered facts outside Figma, where that is a separate step: `script` and its exported `call`, or the service `route` that runs it
$fields.buckets: the fix-queue bucket of each finding: `from` a rules file (rule → b1/b2/b3, `_default`), `rules` with a `default`, or `finding` for checks that set their own
$fields.applies: when the stage runs on a file: `always`; `fact` a fact of the open file (componentSets: it has components, in sets or single; tokens and icons: library.mjs liveApplies), as stages.mjs appliesTo reads it; `setting` a key of the library's audit settings that must be set. runStages asks appliesTo for every runner; the one stage outside it is the dashboard's components stage, which is the page's Audit itself and runs before the loop
$fields.runners: which of dashboard, session and lite run it
